premise.zh: 十二号，展品箱登记为已移交。箱子还在房间里，锁没有动过。你要写的是正式说法。
premise.en: On the 12th the exhibit crate was logged as handed over. The crate is still in the room. The lock is intact. You are here to write the official account.

inspect.zh: 正面写着十一号。背面贴了一条胶带，写着十二号。
inspect.en: The slate says the 11th. A strip of tape on the back says the 12th.

meaning.zh: 有人在十二号补拍过，没有登记。
meaning.en: Someone shot again on the 12th and never logged it.

inspect.zh: 一行被划掉：已移交。旁边补写：已封存。
inspect.en: One line crossed out: HANDED OVER. Written beside it: SEALED.

seal.zh: 已封存。笔迹不算证据，纸算。
seal.en: Sealed. The handwriting is not evidence. The paper is.

meaning.zh: 改这个词的人知道移交，也知道要把它抹掉。
meaning.en: Whoever changed the word knew about the handover. And wanted it gone.

inspect.zh: 最后一条通话：先把箱子挪走。
inspect.en: Last transmission: move the crate first.

seal.en: Sealed. The battery still has charge.

meaning.zh: 箱子是在移交登记之后才被挪走的。
meaning.en: The crate moved after the handover was logged.

inspect.zh: 快递回执，十二号下午。寄件人空着。地址在本地。
inspect.en: Courier receipt, 12th, afternoon. Sender blank. A local address.

seal.zh: 已封存。抽屉就那样开着。

meaning.zh: 展品没有出城。移交是编的。
meaning.en: The exhibit never left town. The handover is fiction.

text.zh: 这房间整个下午都这么大。
text.en: The room was this big all afternoon.

text.zh: 不是我写的。今天只有两个人进过这间屋子，其中一个是我。
text.en: Not my handwriting. Two people came through this room today. One of them was me.

text.zh: 回执上有收件人签名吗。没有。那就别问我。
text.en: Is there a receiving signature on the receipt? No. Then stop asking me.
I was at the door. It was shut.

text.zh: 对讲机响过。串台。片场整天串台。
text.en: The walkie squawked. Crossed channel. Happens all day on a set.

text.zh: 我挪过箱子。空的。你可以写下来。
text.en: I moved the crate. It was empty. Write that down.

desc.zh: 四件都摆上去，两个人也都问过。少一样，纸就退回来。
desc.en: All four attached. Both of them asked. Short of that, the paper comes back.

desc.zh: 拿走几件，就把几件还回去。留一件在手上，房间会替我们说话。
desc.en: Take a few, hand them all back. Hold one and the room speaks for you.

desc.zh: 纸越薄越好。堆到三件，谁的名字都跑不掉。
desc.en: Keep the paper thin. Three items and every name shows.

body.zh: 差额进了档案，两个人的说法都附在后面。箱子留在原位，锁没有动过。按纸归档，就这样。
body.en: The discrepancy is on file. Both accounts are attached. The crate stays where it is, lock intact. Filed as read.

body.zh: 纸太薄。补东西，再交一次。箱子不会自己走。
body.en: Too thin. Bring more. Submit again. The crate is not going anywhere.

body.zh: 你写的东西进不了档。房间还是那个房间，箱子还是那个箱子。
body.en: What you wrote does not go on file. The room is still the room. The crate is still in it.

body.zh: 你拿走多少，就还回多少。纸和房间对得上，别的没人问。
body.en: You took it, you gave it back. Paper agrees with the room. Nobody asks the rest.

body.zh: 你留了一件。房间还在这儿，那件东西也还在。封不上。
body.en: You kept one back. The room is still here. So is the thing. It will not close.

body.zh: 纸上东西不多。箱子不在上面。这一版谁都能签。
body.en: Not much on paper. The crate is not one of them. Anybody can sign this.

body.zh: 三件摆在一起，谁的名字都在上面。没人肯签你这一版。
body.en: Three items together and every name is on the page. Nobody will sign your version.
